capabilities: Convert pasted LaTeX to Obsidian math
Recover missing delimiters and normalize paste artifacts
Edit formulas in a live-preview studio
Create and edit fenced pseudocode blocks
Convert a selection or an entire vault
extras: Paste cleanup is on by default; startup vault scanning and automatic cleanup of opened or changed notes are off by default. Vault scans rewrite notes in place, so the README advises a backup and a trial selection first. All conversion, preview and formatting runs locally with no account, API key or network service.
problem: LaTeX copied from papers or websites often arrives without delimiters or with copy artifacts, so Obsidian shows raw TeX instead of rendered math.
summary: Converts pasted LaTeX into Markdown math Obsidian can render, with a live-preview formula editor and pseudocode blocks.
